sections.html:
Potentially acutely life-threatening presentation

*Indicates Key Condition. This is not an exhaustive list of medical conditions.

nodes.t: Defined as inadequate oxygen delivery to meet metabolic demands
Stabilize: A-B-C-D-D, history and physical exam
nodes.d:
• A- Airway
  • B- Breathing
  • C- Circulation
  • D- Disability (Glasgow coma scale)
  • D- Dextrose check
  • History and physical exam

nodes.t: May have history of congenital heart disease · cool extremities with poor perfusion …
nodes.d:
• May have history of congenital heart disease
  • Cool to extremities with poor perfusion
  • May have abnormal cardiac exam
  • May have signs of heart failure

nodes.t: Often warm to extremities with poor perfusion · may have bounding pulses
nodes.d:
• Often warm to extremities with poor perfusion
  • May have bounding pulses

nodes.t: Cool to extremities with poor perfusion · may have pulsus paradoxus …
nodes.d:
• Cool to extremities with poor perfusion
  • May have normal or abnormal breath sounds
  • May have pulsus paradoxus

nodes.t: Usually has history of blood/fluid loss · cool to extremities with poor perfusion
nodes.d:
• Usually has history of blood/fluid loss
  • Cool to extremities with poor perfusion

• Congenital Heart Disease*
  • Acquired Heart Disease (Eg. Kawasaki Disease* with infarction, cardiomyopathy, myocarditis)
  • Arrhythmia
